paragraphs: Yissakhar of Kefar Barkai: his hands were cut off. He was the reincarnation of Adoni-Bezek, under whose table seventy kings with the thumbs of their hands and great toes cut off used to gather scraps. This is what Pesaḥim (57b) says: 'Blessed is the Merciful One, who exacted Yissakhar's recompense in this world' (Gilgulei Neshamot, letter alef, §2).
